detail.title: Intex HDMI Cable 5 Meter 4K@60Hz Ultra HD
detail.overview: Experience stunning visuals and seamless connectivity with the Intex HDMI Cable. Designed for high performance, this cable supports 4K resolution at 60Hz, delivering crystal-clear picture quality and immersive audio. With a high-speed bandwidth of up to 18Gbps, it ensures smooth transmission without lag. The gold-plated connectors enhance durability and signal stability, while the tough PVC build provides long-lasting strength. Ideal for TVs, laptops, gaming consoles, and home theaters, this 5-meter cable offers flexibility and convenience for all your entertainment needs.
